psychological_meaning: Bitter is often associated with a sense of sophistication and quiet contemplation. It can evoke feelings of maturity and stability, while also suggesting a hint of melancholy or introspection. Its muted nature makes it a versatile backdrop, allowing other colors to take center stage, and it subtly conveys a sense of groundedness and neutrality.
